title: Release
description: Validates a release gate record stored in R2 at releases/<exam-id>/latest.json

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this release record was generated

runId.description: GitHub Actions run ID or Worker invocation ID that produced this record

total.description: Total questions in bank with status=ready

byDomain.description: Per-domain ready question counts keyed by domain code (D1, D2, ...)

allDomainsPresent.description: Every exam domain has at least 1 ready question

noQuarantinedBlocking.description: No quarantined questions that block release (status=quarantined with blocking=true)

status.description: passed = all gates true and release was published; failed = one or more gates false

failureReasons.description: Human-readable reasons why status=failed (omit or empty array when passed)

shardManifest.description: Map of shard filename to question count for this release

sourcesSynced.description: Source IDs that were synced in the run that produced this release

sourcesSkipped.description: Source IDs that were skipped (inactive or errored) in this run
